replicate_allocation: one replicate for every world plus a second for three worlds in every bundle and the fourth world in twenty seed-selected bundles
seed_process: 63-bit root seed from Python secrets.randbits using the host OS CSPRNG; canonical private seed manifest committed by SHA-256 before hidden generation
public_id_policy: opaque randomized world and bundle IDs; no family, stratum, parameter, state, oracle, or reversal fields
